chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ali ibn Saeed al-Raqqi, who said: Suleyman ibn Ja'far al-Ja'fary narrated to me from Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him) who said:

Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to a man: 'Marry the child-bearing one who is not necessarily beautiful, and do not marry the beautiful barren woman, for I will pride myself with you among the nations on the Day of Resurrection. Or do you not know that the children are beneath the Throne seeking forgiveness for their parents? Ibrahim (peace be upon him) cuddles them, and Sarah (peace be upon him) nourishes them in a mountain of Musk, Amber, and Saffron.'
ai.seo_question: Why should one prioritize fertility over beauty in marriage according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Al-Kafi, Imam al-Rida (AS) conveys the Prophet’s preference for fertility over beauty, emphasizing the spiritual merit of progeny who intercede for their parents. The imagery of Ibrahim and Sarah nurturing children in a fragrant mountain highlights the continuity of righteous lineage, a core theme in Shia eschatology. This narration underscores the practical importance of childbearing in marital selection as a means of securing divine pride on the Day of Judgment.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ali Bin Saeed Al Raqqy, from Suleyman Bin Ja’far Al Ja’fary, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said to a man: ‘Marry ‘سَوْءَاءَ’ the child-bearing one, but do not marry a good looking barren woman, for I<sup>saww</sup> would be priding with you all (among) the communities on the Day of Judgement; or do you not know that the children are seeking Forgiveness for their parents beneath the Throne. Ibrahim<sup>as</sup> is cuddling them and Sarah<sup>as</sup> is nourishing them in a mountain of Musk and Amber and Saffron’.
en.sarwar: 4. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ali ibn Sa‘id al-Riqqiy to whom narrated Sulayman ibn Ja’far al- Ja’fariy who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan, al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, once said to a man, ‘Marry al-Su’a’ and child bearing woman but do not marry a good looking barren woman. I will express pride because of you among nations on the Day of Judgment. Have you taken notice that children under the Throne ask forgiveness for their parents? Ibrahim and Sara are the custodians of these children in a mountain of musk, ambergris and saffron.’”
